scorer: RDKit bundled rdkit/Contrib/SA_Score/sascorer.py (canonical Ertl 2009). NOT molmetal/eval/scoring/sascorer.py, whose fragment term is a hardcoded constant -- see molmetal/tests/test_sascorer_fork_divergence.py.
why_the_control_is_required: SA contains a size penalty (nAtoms**1.005 - nAtoms), and the intervention deletes atoms, so an unguarded SA improvement would be indistinguishable from simply having fewer atoms. Arm B deletes the same count of non-stereocentre atoms; the difference between the arms is what is attributable to the stereocentres.
supersedes: cfm_todo.json::OPT_1_MEASURED_2026_10_13, which reported SA 3.3039 -> 4.4189 (+1.115, worse) and closed OPT-1 as INFEASIBLE_AT_DECODE_TIME. Those numbers came from the broken in-tree fork; the sign reverses under the canonical scorer.
what_does_not_change: set_tag and remove_annotation remain VACUOUS -- scorer-independent, because FindMolChiralCenters(includeUnassigned=True) counts assigned centres too. That half of round 8 stands.
